name: Zhuhai Aerospace Microchips Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuhai Aerospace Microchips Science & Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the aerospace electronics business in China. It offers SoC chips, such as single-core SoC chips, multi-core SoC chips, bus control chips, and application development systems; 3D packaged SiP modules and systems, including electronic system modules for core components of aerospace equipment; system integration products comprising embedded bus control modules, embedded intelligent control platforms, and system integration products supported by EMBC and EIPC as technology platforms; big data support and service platform; and AI embedded chips, intelligent image processing and facial recognition, and AI deep learning systems. …
